questions.q: What is the ITIL 4 purpose of the service desk practice?
options: To capture demand for incident resolution and service requests, as the entry point and single point of contact for users
To set clear, business-based targets for service levels
To maintain and improve the effective use of information and knowledge
To assess and authorize proposed changes to the IT environment
questions.explain: The service desk's purpose is capturing demand for incidents and requests while serving as the single point of contact between the provider and its users.

questions.q: Why does ITIL 4 define the service desk as a "single point of contact" rather than by a specific channel like a phone line?
options: Because ITIL 4 requires every service desk to operate only by phone
Because the service desk is defined by being the one place users go, regardless of which channel they use to reach it
Because a single point of contact means only one employee can ever staff the service desk
Because channels other than phone calls are not considered part of ITSM
questions.explain: ITIL 4 broadens the service desk beyond any one channel — what defines it is being the single point of contact, however a user reaches it.

questions.q: Which of the following reflects ITIL 4's view of acceptable service desk channels?
options: Only phone calls answered by a live human qualify as true service desk contact
Self-service portals and chatbots replace the need for a service desk practice entirely
A self-service portal, live chat, email, phone, walk-up support, and AI-driven chatbots can all be valid front doors to the same single point of contact
Each channel must be run as a completely separate, unconnected practice
questions.explain: ITIL 4 explicitly broadens the service desk to cover multiple channels, as long as they all feed the same consistent intake and routing process.

questions.q: According to ITIL 4, what is the service desk's value primarily measured by?
options: The total number of tickets closed in a given shift, regardless of how they were handled
How quickly a call can be transferred away from the service desk
How few channels the service desk makes available to users
Empathy, clear communication, and fast, accurate triage, not simply the number of tickets closed per hour
questions.explain: ITIL 4 stresses empathy and effective communication alongside accurate triage as the real measure of service desk value, not raw ticket throughput.

questions.q: A user reports an issue through a chatbot at night, gets a case number, and a technician resolves it the next morning. Per ITIL 4's definition, was the service desk practice at work?
options: No — service desk activity only counts if a live human answers in real time
Yes — the chatbot is a valid channel into the same single point of contact, and the request was still captured, logged, and routed
No — a chatbot can never be considered part of the service desk practice
It depends on whether the issue turned out to be an incident or a service request
questions.explain: ITIL 4 does not require a specific channel or real-time human response — the chatbot capturing and routing the request is itself service desk activity.
